comment: Every HTTP route the dashboard issues, and why. Three things read this file, which is why
it exists rather than the URLs being scattered through the components:
1. src/api/client.ts builds its request paths from it, so a route cannot drift out of
this list without the UI breaking loudly.
2. tests/api_contract_test.rs asserts every entry is covered by CONTRACTS, so a route
the dashboard depends on cannot stop being served without a Rust test failing -- on
the default feature set, with no Node and no built bundle.
3. tests/api/test_dashboard.py replays them against a live server.
The list is read-only by construction. It contains GETs and the five POSTs that only read
(search and list are POSTs because their bodies are too structured for a query string).
POST /api/v1/query is deliberately absent: DXQL executes INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and DROP,
so a console for it would make the phrase 'read-only dashboard' false.
